Hoshino Yukinobu
Manben: Behind the Scenes of Manga with Urasawa Naoki
This time, we go behind the scenes of manga creation with sci-fi master Hoshino Yukinobu. 
Marvel at the power of the pen as Hoshino works on incredible ocean scenery for his epic, Kaitei.
